continuum.eyebrow: A proprietary Continuum of Care model
continuum.title: The 5-Stage Path to Homeownership
continuum.intro: A structured, non-arbitrary progression. Each stage has clear eligibility, documented progression, and non-arbitrary movement.

stages.name: Crisis / Pre-Housing
stages.description: Partner-delivered services. Homeless or unstably housed. No housing yet.

stages.name: Stabilization Housing
stages.description: Program-controlled units. Case management. No lease obligation.

stages.name: Rent-Ready
stages.description: Transitional lease. Repair participation. Benchmarks tracked.
stages.detail: Focus on budgeting and behavior benchmarks.

stages.name: Path to Homeownership
stages.description: Lease-Option / Agreement for Deed. Credit coaching. Work-for-equity.
stages.detail: Focus on credit coaching and escrowed equity.

stages.name: Ownership / Exit
stages.description: Mortgage or payoff. Alumni tracking. Full independence.

continuum.closingQuote: From Crisis to Keys — a structured, non-arbitrary progression.

wellness.title: Housing is Healthcare
wellness.sdohNote: The WEL9 Methodology is built on the same five Social Determinants of Health domains used across the housing and healthcare fields — connecting our housing model to the broader evidence base funders and health systems already recognize.
